label: Bible Study
prompt: Jesus said unto her, I am the _____, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verse: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
note: Spoken to Martha at Lazarus' tomb — four days in, and about to be very much alive.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: We love him, because he _____ loved us.
verse: We love him, because he first loved us.
note: Our love is always a reply — He said it first, and we're just answering back.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not _____.
verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
note: The burning bush's real wonder wasn't the fire — it was that the bush was not consumed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the _____, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
verse: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
note: Jonah grieved a one-night plant more than Nineveh's 120,000 people — and the book ends on God's unanswered question.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that _____ out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
verse: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
note: Jesus answered Satan's first temptation with this verse: not bread only, but every word that 'proceedeth.'
